root_text:
🚨🚨 BREAKING: An 80-year-old man in Ahmedabad has tested positive for Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV).

He is currently stable and receiving treatment at a private hospital.

This follows Gujarat’s first reported case on January 6. #HMPVinIndi
